conflicts.remarks_quote: Because edges have no natural direction, you cannot necessarily predict which of the two points you will get first and which last.
conflicts.example_quote: Set ver1 = swedge.GetStartVertex … AsyRadius1 = swFeatData.GetRadius2(ver1, True) … If AsyRadius1 <> 0.008 Then ErrorMsg SwApp, "Radius R1 at vertex V1 is wrong"
conflicts.why: Remarks 说先/后不可预测；示例却把 GetStartVertex 固定当 V1 并断言半径必须是 0.008，否则报错。两侧不能同时成立。

conflicts.remarks_quote: Because edges have no natural direction, you cannot necessarily predict which of the two points you will get first and which last.
conflicts.example_quote: ver1 = (Vertex)swedge.GetStartVertex(); … AsyRadius1 = swFeatData.GetRadius2(ver1, out boolstatus); … if (AsyRadius1 != 0.008) ErrorMsg(swApp, "Radius R1 at vertex V1 is wrong");
conflicts.why: C# 版与 VBA 版同形：把「起点=0.008 半径、终点=0.009 半径」当确定映射并断言，与 Remarks 的不可预测说冲突。

conflicts.remarks_quote: If no vertex exists for this edge (such as the edge of a newly created cylinder), then this method returns null.
conflicts.why: Remarks 写明无顶点时返回 null；示例取到即 .GetPoint 不判空，遇到这类边两者不能同时成立。
